name: Thunder Tiger Corp.
summary: Thunder Tiger Corp. is a global manufacturer and distributor primarily renowned for its remote-controlled (RC) cars. Beyond its core RC vehicle offerings, the company provides a diverse range of RC craft, encompassing speedboats, sailing yachts, and submersible models. Its product line further includes rotary-wing aircraft such as helicopters and quadcopters, fixed-wing airplanes like gliders and park flyers, various electronic components, and a comprehensive selection of accessories. Originally known as Thunder Tiger Model Company Limited, the enterprise officially adopted its current designation, Thunder Tiger Corp., in 1997. The firm was established in 1979 and maintains its principal operations and corporate headquarters in Taichung City, Taiwan.
